feeds.title: Creative Dioramas
feeds.description: Explore my collection of self-built dioramas in this blog. I started building plastic models at a very young age. At some point I realized it would be more interesting to create an entire scene with models instead of just displaying them on a shelf. I've been making dioramas ever since. I am an artist, musician, filmmaker and author. My first book, Songwriting Made Simple, was published in 2014.

feeds.title: Kathy Millatt Modelling » Scenery & Dioramas
feeds.description: Browse through my scenario and diorama collection and stories in this section. I'm Kathy Millatt and I love modelling - big and small! I model railways, sci fi and anything else that grabs my fancy and my first love is scenery.
